name: qlrisk_price_crypto_perpetual
title: Price a CryptoPerpetual
description:
Price one Cryptocurrency Perpetual (qlrisk CryptoPerpetual).
Inputs (* required, name=default): position_value=1000000, ticker, quantity, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: maturity, effective_date, position.
Example: {"position_value": 1000000, "ticker": "AAPL"} gives NPV 1,000,000.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
